other_model_warning: Keldin is tuned and checked against the recommended model for this Mac. Results may vary with other models or quantisations, including question quality, difficulty, factual accuracy, mark schemes, and structured-output reliability.

tiers.title: Memory-compatible choice
tiers.detail: Fits the tighter memory budget of an 8 GB Apple-silicon Mac. It is a compatibility choice, so carefully review every question and mark scheme before use.
tiers.quality_note: Smaller models have less capacity for long, source-based questions and detailed level-of-response mark schemes.

tiers.title: Recommended for paper quality
tiers.detail: The best balance of instruction following, subject reasoning, structured output, and local memory use for this assessment-writing workflow. A Mac with at least 16 GB unified memory is recommended.
tiers.quality_note: Keep other memory-heavy apps closed while generating a full paper.
